The postmortem has been completed, and the root cause of the job failures has been identified. The issue was due to a configuration change that caused the jobs to fail. The team has been instructed to revert the change and re-run the jobs.

Submit_report: The root cause of the job failures has been identified and addressed. The postmortem has been completed, and the team has been instructed to revert the configuration change and re-run the jobs. Next step: monitor the jobs and ensure they are running successfully.
